bearing_diagnostics.interpretation: Historical receiver-signature 1/n diagnostics retained. The raw universal lower-bound wording is unsupported: these are neither qualified NDS factors nor established whole-joint conservative bounds. Before-Cg values are local references, not complete connection capacities.

full_shaft_elastic.interpretation: Nominal circular-section material thresholds only. Fy/5 is arbitrary, not an NDS design value. Grade8 is a strength-only scenario on the 90 J429-labeled axes, not a product selection, fit check, A574 substitution or connection pass.
full_shaft_elastic.method_comparison: These values are not a same-formula three-way pass comparison: the direct-elastic-family index uses Fy/2 and omits T; the same-field envelope uses the pinned circular-section T/V/M/N helper with conservative interval maxima; the signed-cut value evaluates the fresh field's simultaneous six-component vectors at discrete stations. The governing case/axis matches, but neither the 0.420165-to-MPa difference nor the same-field-to-cut difference is attributed to torsion alone.

torsion_census.interpretation: All saved/current T values are zero within 1e-8 Nmm; raw field roundoff reaches only the listed maximum. The continuous same-field envelope explicitly includes T, but it contributes no material stress at this tolerance.

criterion_dispositions.evidence_scope: All 108 axes have fresh per-receiver signed actions, local couples and conditional same-field material thresholds. Force-only TR 12 covers 88 two-media axes;20 three-media axes are explicitly outside that subcheck. Historical 1/n acceptance is withdrawn; all 15 diagnostic rows remain. A source-bound point-of-application check covers all 792 wood actions; all 48 rear receiver actions retain an irreducible moment above 1e-4 Nmm even for an unrestricted force point. This is a load-mapping result, not a strength flag. The exact rear isolated coupon is reusable by input/kernel identity and does not reproduce the NDS gamma; this does not waive group action.
criterion_dispositions.missing_method: Define compatible simultaneous force/moment/axial/torsional resistance for actual unequal media and physical rows, including local splitting. Existing FE foundation coefficients are not demonstrated equivalent to NDS serial-row gamma; neither automatic Cg=1 nor multiplying receiver-signature 1/n is qualified.

criterion_dispositions.next_action: Resolve the 8 flagged axes by physical receiver cluster, preserving all seven cleat pins and shared header fittings. Choose applicable NDS mode/row branches or a supported mechanics wrench envelope before changing bolt count/diameter.

group_method_next_actions.EA_input: Use gross member areas. For a member loaded perpendicular to grain, use the source-defined equivalent area from thickness and fastener-group width; handle the single-row width rule explicitly. Identify the actual gross steel section and participating members; formed-fitting bending cannot be assumed identical to a straight axial strip.
group_method_next_actions.route_A: Use applicable NDS row/mode procedures plus supported component/interactions for the concurrent signed couples and local splitting. Do not silently collapse the current complete wrench to scalar P/Z.
group_method_next_actions.route_B: For a separately justified mechanics route, establish its resistance/interaction and compatible slip law. If constitutive inputs change, prepare a matched six-case/replay bank; an unchanged convergence rerun cannot supply the missing method.
group_method_next_actions.row_input: Identify same-diameter fastener rows aligned with the relevant load. Apply the stated staggered-row merging rule; receiver-name signatures do not establish those rows.
group_method_next_actions.wood_metal_boundary: Cg acts on applicable lateral connection Z values, not independent metal strength. Source mode and multi-fastener summation applicability remain necessary.

local_full_wrench_lower_bound.distinct_affine_pressure_reference: The retained 4*Ktheta/Hankinson local pressure reference is a separate reduced Mode-I-like screen; neither it nor the common-divisor-five reference is a complete minimum of all applicable connection modes.
local_full_wrench_lower_bound.next_method: A justified mapping to appropriate component/mode checks with a supported interaction can be used; a complete 3D numerical model is not declared mandatory. Any alternative must preserve the recorded forces, moments and transfer interfaces, and address group and splitting separately.
local_full_wrench_lower_bound.reason: TR12 defines a minimum of mode-specific connection P/Rd values. It does not establish that the separate common FeD/5 and pure bending screens are a complete admissible full-wrench yield field. Current line-pressure and shaft equilibrium residuals do not establish that broader claim.

moment_reference_point_check.formula: M_shifted=M_source-t*(e cross F); minimize the residual over the actual media interval. For an unrestricted point, the invariant residual is |F dot M|/|F|.
moment_reference_point_check.interpretation: The recorded moments cannot generally be eliminated by relabeling their application point. Zero residual establishes geometric wrench equivalence only; it does not qualify a force-only capacity check or clear any diagnostic.

splitting_source_reuse.demand_mapping: The source uses member section shears on the two sides of the connection, not a sum of bolt cross-grain force magnitudes. The loaded edge, host plane, actual finished he/h/b, concurrent groups and off-plane/couple effects need an applicable mapping.
splitting_source_reuse.equation: F90,Rk=14*b*w*sqrt(he/(1-he/h)); ordinary-fastener w=1 within the stated source arrangement.
splitting_source_reuse.named_historical_scenario: EN1995-1-1:2004 corrected by AC:2006; non-regulatory characteristic host-plane scenario only.
splitting_source_reuse.source_available: The existing CEN corrigendum and JRC figure reproductions establish the corrected characteristic equation and definitions. The cached corrigendum is not the full standard or a complete design-conversion source.
